run_locallaunch_cli: run the locallaunch CLI with a YAML config file to submit local jobs
run_locallaunch_dryrun: run the locallaunch CLI with --dryrun to prepare jobs without launching them
run_locallaunch_jobtype: run the locallaunch CLI with --jobtype to force a specific job type
create_joblauncher: create a JobLauncher from a YAML file and call it to submit a local job
create_pipeline: create a Pipeline from a YAML config to load and save task configs as YAML files
